title: Gram determinant: det(F*∘F) is the square of the frame-coordinate determinant
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, F : ℝⁿ → ℝᴾ a continuous linear map and τ = (τ₁, …, τₙ) an orthonormal family in ℝᴾ such that F eⱼ ∈ span{τ₁, …, τₙ} for every j, where eⱼ = EuclideanSpace.single j 1 is the standard basis of ℝⁿ. Then det(F*∘F) = (det 𝒜)², where F* is the adjoint of F, det(F*∘F) is the determinant of the endomorphism F.adjoint ∘L F of ℝⁿ (ContinuousLinearMap.det), and 𝒜ᵢⱼ := ⟨τᵢ, F eⱼ⟩.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid P) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → (∀ j, F (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ)) → (F.adjoint ∘L F).det = (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (τ i) (F (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))).det ^ 2
